name_zh: 邓小平/中国/改革开放/南巡/猫论/实事求是/特区
name_en: Deng Xiaoping/China/Reform Opening/Southern Tour/Cat Theory/Seek Truth/SEZ
description_zh: 邓小平 (1904-1997) 中国改革开放总设计师，"不管黑猫白猫抓住老鼠就是好猫" 打破教条，1978 年改革开放启动，1992 南巡讲话定调发展硬道理，深圳/珠海/汕头/厦门四大特区开启对外开放，实事求是确立务实路线，一国两制构想香港/澳门回归。
description_en: Deng Xiaoping (1904-1997) China reform opening chief architect, "black cat white cat" broke dogma, 1978 reform opening launched, 1992 Southern Tour set development hard truth, Shenzhen/Zhuhai/Shantou/Xiamen four SEZs opened opening-up, seek truth from facts established pragmatic line, one country two systems envisioned Hong Kong/Macau return.
reason_zh: 邓小平代表革命领袖如何在晚年完成从阶级斗争到经济建设的历史性转向，展示了实事求是如何作为方法论解冻教条僵局，其南巡讲话以个人政治资本押注改革方向，改变了中国与世界命运。
reason_en: Deng represents how revolutionary leader in late life completed historic turn from class struggle to economic construction, demonstrating how seek truth from facts as methodology thawed dogmatic deadlock, his Southern Tour staking personal political capital on reform direction, changing China and world destiny.

分析1978十一届三中全会/真理标准讨论/改革启动
探讨1984十四大/特区立法/沿海开放/一国两制

总结改革开放/猫论/实事求是/特区/南巡五重遗产
steps_en: Study Deng early France work-study/Long March/three purges
Explore 1984 14th Congress/SEZ legislation/coastal opening/one country two systems
Evaluate 1992 Southern Tour/development hard truth/three favors/Wu Bangguo
Summarize reform opening/cat theory/seek truth/SEZ/Southern Tour quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握实事求是如何作为方法论解冻教条与启动改革，理解特区作为制度创新试验田的战略定位，评估邓小平改革开放对中国现代化与世界格局的决定性重塑。
expected_en: Master how seek truth from facts as methodology thaws dogma and launches reform, grasp SEZ as institutional innovation testbed strategic positioning, evaluate Deng reform opening decisive reshaping of China modernization and world order.
case_zh: 1978 改革开放；1984 特区/一国两制；1992 南巡；1997 逝世。改革开放/猫论/实事求是/特区/南巡范式永存。
case_en: 1978 reform opening; 1984 SEZ/one country two systems; 1992 Southern Tour; 1997 death. Reform opening/cat theory/seek truth/SEZ/Southern Tour paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Chinese Pragmatism / Socialist Market Economy / Reformism
cross_cultural_impact: Reform opening; cat theory; SEZ; one country two systems; pragmatic governance
